description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Notifying that Fiscal Management Report 2017 including Fiscal Strategy Statement  2017 & Budget Economic & Fiscal Position Report 2017 is available for inspection
categorisation: This gazette notification concerns the publication and availability of the Fiscal Management Report - 2017, which is issued under the Fiscal Management (Responsibility) Act, No. 3 of 2003. The content is focused on a regulatory and statutory requirement for reporting on fiscal management, making it a matter of legal and regulatory framework rather than government personnel, structure, or any other specialized category.
